title: the base shim no longer masks exit 3 when it starts the ground loop, and its notes say the loser exits quietly
intention: ensure_ground_loop in the base shim starts the ground loop's unit without -p SuccessExitStatus=3, and its three notes say a singleton loser exits 0 quietly, so a loser that regresses to the loud exit 3 reads as a failed unit again.
why: Measured 2026-11-13: b38af5fd1852 (35711160e, Akien's Q#93 answer, outline 5.3.5.2.1) made the ground loop's loser exit 0. cairn/tools/base/shim.py:194 still passes -p SuccessExitStatus=3 when a shim starts the loop (ensure_ground_loop), and the notes at lines 215, 225 and 241 say 'loser exits 3'. Same shape as superclaude's, fixed by 15e64f9fe960; the base shim is a different component, so it is its own ticket (RULE 1).
traces_to: Law 5 (the thing and its story may not contradict) and Law 7 (a regression to a loud exit must not be hidden).
how: Delete the -p SuccessExitStatus=3 pair from ensure_ground_loop's systemd-run argv; reword the three notes to say a loser exits 0 quietly. One proof reads the function's source with ast and the file's text, so it runs on any OS.

clauses.claim: ensure_ground_loop's systemd-run argv no longer carries -p SuccessExitStatus=3, where it did
shim.py no longer says the ground loop's singleton loser exits 3, in any note, where it said so in three places

decisions.text: D1: remove the flag and reword the three notes in shim.py.
D2: one proof reading the source, one tooth per clause; red first, and red on a hollow build.

out: the base charter (it does not tell this story; checked)

measured.saw: shim.py:194 passes '-p', 'SuccessExitStatus=3' in ensure_ground_loop's systemd-run argv; notes at lines 215, 225 and 241 say 'singleton guard decides; loser exits 3'. cairn/tools/base/intention+why.json holds no mention of exits 3, SuccessExitStatus or the loser. No proof asserts the flag or the note text.
measured.how: grep -n over shim.py; json walk of the base charter; grep of proofs for the note text
